goal: Prevent node crashes from file descriptor exhaustion by capping connections on IPC listeners
Allow operators to configure independent connection limits across different IPC clients
agreement: Strong support for per-listener limits to prevent descriptor exhaustion (ryanofsky)
Prefers per-address configuration over a single global limit (kevkevinpal)
Verified by testing connection limits across multiple clients on macOS and Linux (xyzconstant)
Concept approval for future extensibility to interface whitelisting (Sjors)

categories.name: ipc
why: P2 because it protects nodes from file descriptor exhaustion crashes under heavy IPC socket usage
Enables distinct connection limits for different IPC clients such as GUIs and mining setups
